text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sheesh, this is completely boring!!
Fine then, whatever, I don't care!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Forget this boring stuff,
let's go get parfaits, Familiar!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph! Whatever, I don't care!
I wasn't even going all out today anyway!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So I'm not... frustrated at all...
not even a bit...!
choice_data_list: Let's do a proper review and put what we learn to use next time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
“B-But, still...!
That didn't feel good at aaaaall...!”

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I'll never become a witch like this!
No way, I won't accept that!"
choice_data_list: It's okay, you'll win next time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Of course! 
I can't just keep losing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely going to win next time!
You'd better help me out properly too, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, isn't that a familiar's job?!
You need to figure that out properly yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious?
I'm going to research the magic of victory!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I am never, EVER gonna lose again!
